generation.scope: For every pure reduced quartic point graph with disjoint finite residual, the only possible singular curves are the two-conic nodal cycle and the spatial four-line cycle. Both have length-four residual and fixed-point-free canonical rotation with second difference of order at most two. Two explicit polygon coefficient charts have finite all-degree AS, isomorphism, and minimum-period tests, including all zero-coordinate strata.

open_mathematics: Analyze existence and dimensions of the two polygon coefficient charts and use the cotangent formula on embedded or higher degree curves. Address the general AS test and positive-dimensional projection fibers.
